_doc: Level-owned lines for Rustvane Canyon (bs.rustvane.*). Same shape as lines_index.json (id -> who/text). LevelKit.register_lines merges them into VOManager at level load; the lead adds ['bs/levels/rustvane_lines', 'lines'] to VOManager.LINE_SOURCES. The bs.level.* entries repeat the shared level-kit lines from scrapheap_lines.json (same text) so Rustvane works when it is the first planet loaded.

bs.rustvane.strip_mine_sub.text: Where the resort gets its "authentic canyon" gravel

bs.rustvane.hook.01.text: Bolt. This winch hauled ore up these cliffs for sixty years. The cable's still good. Co-op cable. They over-engineered EVERYTHING.

bs.rustvane.hook.03.text: I can make it ME. I fly the cable up, I grab a ring, you swing. I'm the anchor now. Structurally AND emotionally.

bs.rustvane.hook.05.text: One mechanic. ONE. So maybe ease off the sandwiches.

bs.rustvane.hook_sub.text: K / D-pad down: swing on ORANGE rings, reel up to GREEN ones

bs.rustvane.hint_hook_course.text: Practice rings! Jump at the trench, look at the ORANGE ring and press K / D-pad down. JUMP to let go.

bs.rustvane.hint_pull.text: GREEN rings are pull points: look at one and press K / D-pad down to reel up the cliff.

bs.rustvane.hint_need_hook.text: That ledge is way up. Those green rings are Co-op cable anchors... the old winch at the Co-op Camp could help.

bs.rustvane.course_sub.text: The Co-op approves. Silently. With a nod.

bs.rustvane.badge_sub.text: Valid for: the staff lift, the Strip Mine. Not valid for: breaks.

bs.rustvane.hint_badge.text: STAFF ONLY. The time clock in Back of House prints badges.

bs.rustvane.hint_lift.text: The staff lift climbs to the Strip Mine rim. The scenic zip line leaves from up there.

bs.rustvane.hint_updraft.text: Warm air off the pit! Stand in the dust and hold JUMP to ride the updraft up.

bs.rustvane.hint_mine.text: A collapsed Co-op mine. Those back timbers look very dry. Very flammable.

bs.rustvane.hint_roost.text: A cliff roost high on the east wall, with a green Co-op ring at the lip.

bs.rustvane.hint_gantry.text: The ore gantry is up there. Reel up to its green ring, then ride the line over the quarry fence.

bs.rustvane.vip_sub.text: Wristband printed. Please enjoy the descent responsibly.

bs.rustvane.security_sub.text: The Sentinel's clearance is yours now

bs.rustvane.hint_vip_wait.text: VIP gate: WRISTBAND from the Top Billboard Deck, SECURITY from the Rustvane Sentinel in the Strip Mine.

bs.rustvane.ship_ready.text: Ship's warm. Say the word and I'll plot us a course off this two-star rock.

bs.rustvane.concierge_idle.text: Reviews down, towels home. Your stay has been rated 'adequate'. That is our highest honour.

bs.rustvane.bellhop_idle.text: Jars home, whistles quiet. Somebody under the pool laughed just now. Out loud. On the clock.

bs.rustvane.qhint_q2a.text: Hear that shutter click? Somebody nearby is about to get one-starred.

bs.rustvane.qhint_q2b.text: A towel, flapping in the wind. It sounds... free. We're about to ruin that.

bs.rustvane.qhint_q2c.text: Coins rattling. That's a tip jar trying to come home.

bs.rustvane.qhint_q2d.text: A whistle. A Lifeguard Bot is enforcing a break somewhere close.

bs.rustvane.capsule_sub.text: 100 bolts and a photo of sixty years of people who owned their jobs

bs.rustvane.roost_sub.text: 60 bolts and ammo nobody billed you for

bs.rustvane.vending_sub.text: 120 bolts. The machine looks away first.

bs.rustvane.adsun_sub.text: 150 bolts. One sun, as nature intended.

bs.rustvane.firmware_sub.text: Opera, Whisper, Legal Disclaimer... and one we don't talk about

bs.rustvane.popup_sub.text: A GLAMBOT Pop-Up Segment! Stay out of the plunge pool for a 25% bonus

bs.rustvane.popup_glambot.text: Darlings, we are LIVE from the Quarry Floor! I had the poolside furniture trucked in. Try not to die on the loungers, they're rented.
